title: Hook Composition Patterns
description: Learn how to compose multiple custom hooks together to build complex stateful logic while maintaining clean separation of concerns.

data.text: Custom hooks become exponentially more powerful when you compose them together. Rather than building monolithic hooks that handle everything, you can break logic into small, focused hooks and combine them to create sophisticated behaviors.

A single hook that manages fetching, caching, error handling, and retry logic quickly becomes impossible to test and reuse. By composing smaller hooks like `useFetch`, `useDebounce`, and `useRetry`, you gain flexibility and testability.

data.title: Single Responsibility
data.text: Each custom hook should do one thing well. If you cannot describe a hook's purpose in one sentence, it is probably doing too much.
The simplest form of composition is calling hooks sequentially inside another hook. The parent hook orchestrates the child hooks and returns a unified API.

data.text: Some hooks run independently and can be composed in parallel. A common pattern is a `useAsync` hook that composes `useLoading`, `useError`, and `useData` states.

data.title: Parallel Async State Hook
data.content: Composing three state hooks into one async data hook.

data.title: Setter Closures
data.text: When composing hooks, remember that state setters are stable across renders. However, if you need reactive loading state, manage it inside the composed hook rather than relying on a child hook's internal state.

data.title: Composition Guidelines
items: Keep hooks pure in their inputs and outputs
Return stable references with useCallback and useMemo
Accept configuration objects as the last parameter
Name composed hooks with a `use` prefix
Document which hooks are safe to compose together

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Compose small, single-purpose hooks instead of building monoliths
Sequential composition orchestrates child hooks inside a parent hook
Parallel composition runs independent hooks side by side
Always return stable references from composed hooks
data.takeaway: Hook composition is the primary mechanism for building scalable stateful logic in React.
